THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 08.08.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 CRL.MC NO. 3921 OF 2025  3  2025:KER:62602  ORDER Dated this the 8th day of August, 2025

The petitioners are accused Nos.1 to 3 in Crime No.589 of 2023 registered at the Kalady Police Station for the offence punishable under Section 420 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, now pending as C.C No.99 of 2024 on the files of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IV, Perumbavoor.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-IV, Perumbavoor
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned Counsel for the petitioners submitted that the dispute, which led to the incident and registration of the crime, is amicably settled and Annexure-A5 affidavit has been filed by the 3 rd respondent vouching this fact.
3. Learned Counsel for the 3rd respondent also submitted that the dispute is settled and his client has no grievance against the petitioners.
4. I heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

Having considered the gravity of the offence alleged and having perused the affidavit, the contents of which are vouched to be true and voluntary by the Counsel for the 3rd respondent, I am satisfied that no public interest is involved in this matter and the dispute has been settled amicably.
In view of the settlement, there is no possibility of the criminal proceedings ending in conviction.

As such,
